component.name: Nuvio
component.summary: Discover movies and shows, keep your library and watch progress in sync

description.p: Discover movies and shows, save favorites and watch from your own library.

Nuvio is a Qt Quick media center for Linux: addon catalogs, torrent and debrid playback, offline downloads, Trakt/SIMKL scrobbling, and watch-state sync that stays data-compatible with the Compose product line.
